why: Fixes the root cause of bot-opened PRs getting no pull_request CI (PI-20260926-DP2BHGT3-0001): claude-pr-automerge.yml's PAT-authenticated PR-open path, plus the CI guards that pin its shape (scripts/ci/check_automerge_trigger.py C6, scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py R13's remedy text) and their test coverage. All Tier-1 by content (.github/**, scripts/ci/**, tests/**, docs/**; no runtime/order-path/config/account file touched), but the diff is on R12's own LANDING_MACHINERY list -- the workflow this PR edits is the one that would open and arm auto-merge on it, and the guard scripts this PR edits are the ones that would grade it. A mistake in either disarms the check that would have caught the mistake, so this holds for a human read rather than self-landing, per check_pr_landing.py's own docstring ('This file's own PR is the first instance').
